# gitee-mcp

Bridge to Gitee (gitee.com), China's largest open-source platform: humming radar, repo intel, search, zh->en translation.

## Core

- [README](README.md) - overview and quick start
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md) - all install methods
- [docs/](docs/README.md) - full documentation stack
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) - complete LLM-readable documentation

## Tools

- gitee_explore - humming radar, momentum deltas, top-starred/top-forked, seeds
- gitee_repo - details, readme, languages, commits, contents, branches, stack, releases, star history
- gitee_search - users (anonymous), repos (token, cross-lingual), user repos
- gitee_translate - zh->en via local LLM, detect, status, culture explain
- gitee_webhook - inbound event feed + grouped digest
- gitee_watchlist - persistent watchlist with change detection
- gitee_ecosystem - ecosystem graph, GitHub mirror, weekly digest, RSS feed
- gitee_corpus - README keyword corpus search (BM25 FTS5, RAG-lite)
- show_gitee_humming_card / show_gitee_status_card - Prefab cards
- gitee_shutdown - graceful self-termination

## Quick start

```
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/gitee-mcp
cd gitee-mcp && uv sync
uv run python -m gitee_mcp.server        # stdio (Claude Desktop)
./start.bat                              # full stack: backend 11161 + webapp 11162
```

Anonymous tier works out of the box. GITEE_TOKEN (free) unlocks repo search.
Ollama enables full zh->en translation.
